name: Spicomellus
isnote: First thought stegosaurian from the type rib; the 2025 specimen shows it is an ankylosaur (Maidment et al. 2025), but its position inside Ankylosauria is not settled in the sources used.
sum: Spicomellus is the oldest known ankylosaur, from the Middle Jurassic of Morocco, with extremely elongated spikes fused directly to the ribs.
holotype: A dorsal rib fragment fused to a flat osteoderm bearing four spines — El Mers III Formation, Morocco (collection number not given in the sources used).
material: A partial skeleton described in 2025 with cranial bones, vertebrae, ribs bearing fused spikes and both scapulocoracoids.
biology: Unique among vertebrates in having dermal spikes fused to the ribs; the largest spike is 87 cm long.
author: Maidment et al. 2021
